summary: W62 reproduces a later in-place atlas error leaving changed predecessor pixels on the real desktop GL route. Retry matches the authored pixels under the same original names with pack and unpack state preserved. All 46 Release regression groups, the controlled GL fixtures and Flat and Full startup checks pass.

scope: Late recoverable errors in desktop block atlas batches with stable same-size texture identities
composition_rule: Upload scratch holds the maximum row. The rollback request holds the sum of the byte extents of reusable rows and is bounded by row count times the maximum row, plus the pinned STL large allocation prefix. The buffer covers only the publication phase and retires along with the stage. Keep driver-owned backing separate from requested CPU bytes.
